ITEM 1 | Small grain-like mass, tan to light brown with a slightly glossy, separate-kernel texture, forming the main bulk of the mound in the center-left of the plate, about 9 cm across and 1.5 cm high, mixed with some dark green leafy bits and thin pale strands | 110
ITEM 2 | Thin yellow slices, pale golden with slightly translucent edges and soft, slightly wilted texture, arranged in curled overlapping pieces about 4 to 5 cm long on the right side of the mound | 35
ITEM 3 | Dark green elongated piece, glossy and smooth, lying across the top of the mound, about 4 cm long and 0.8 cm wide, possibly a stalk with a slightly curved tip | 8
ITEM 4 | Small whole red cherry tomato, glossy bright red with smooth skin, about 2 cm in diameter, sitting separately on the left edge of the mound | 8
ITEM 5 | Cluster of small red and yellow tomato pieces, soft and slightly shiny, halved or chunked, about 2.5 cm across, tucked at the bottom front edge of the mound | 10
ITEM 6 | Scattered dark green leaf fragments, wilted and glossy, a few small pieces, about 0.5 to 1 cm each, woven through the grain mound | 4
